name: solstice-wave-festival
description: Demo festival site: Astro + SQLite (Cloudflare D1) with VIP/Admin gating via a pretend delegate login

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && npx e9core build-plugins && node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs dev
scripts.db:path: find .wrangler/state/v3/d1 -name '*.sqlite' 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'No local D1 SQLite file yet — run npm run db:migrate first'
